Name: (FS) Animated and Dyeable Shrimp Accessories
Author: suushiico
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/EGhuVix.gif[/img][/center][center]Adds 3 unique shrimp accessories and hats with 12 accessory variations and 14 hat variations using Fashion Sense.﻿[/center][b][size=6]
Installation
[/size][/b]
You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download any .zip files under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder. There are four versions: [b]non-dyeable[/b] and [b]dyeable [/b][i]accessories[/i], and [b]non-dyeable[/b] and [b]dyeable [/b][i]hats[/i].

You can download just one [i]or[/i] any number of them - it works either way!

[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Where can I get the accessories?
[/b][/size]You must acquire the [i]Hand Mirror[/i] from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] mod. Interact with it, then scroll through the [i]Accessories [/i]or [i]Hats[/i] sections to equip!

[b]What are the 12 accessories?[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Animated [/b]shrimp head (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Animated [/b]shrimp antennae (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Animated [/b]shrimp whiskers (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*]Shrimp bows (both sides, left side, right side, and dyeable versions of each)
[/list]
[b]What are the 14 hats?[/b][list]
[*][size=2][b]Animated [/b]shrimp head (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Animated [/b]shrimp antennae (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Animated [/b]shrimp whiskers (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Animated[/b] Antennae + whiskers combo (classic and dyeable versions)[/size]
[*][size=2]Shrimp bows (both sides, left side, right side, and dyeable versions of each[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4][b]What mods are you using in the screenshots?[/b][/size]﻿[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]
[/list]
[i]Update 24-MAY-2024: this mod page has been combined with the previously-separated Hats version. Both hats and accessory versions of the items are available on this page only. The Hats-exclusive mod is now hidden to direct users to this mod.[/i]
